messages:
maria (sec): Heads up — we have an incoming pen test scheduled for next Tue 09:00-13:00 PT. Need to confirm RBAC windows, KMS evidence access, and a retest cadence. Who can own the access plan?
ajay: I can. primary asks: ephemeral roles for assessors, read-only log bundles, and a presigned S3 path for evidence.
kevin (infra): +1 for ephemeral. We should use the KMS proxy for decrypt-only keys during the window. Means we hand out an IAM role that can call sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity -> proxy handles decrypt ops.
donna (sre): Oncall coverage? I can cover the first two hours, @kevin can take the rest. Also want a rollback corridor if anything touches prod.
ajay: Proposed RBAC plan: 1) create assessor role with time-bound session (4h) 2) restrict to specific ARNs (s3:ListBucket, s3:GetObject on evidence bucket) 3) deny write and network-change actions 4) log all AssumeRole ops to audit log.
kevin (infra): Implementation notes: Use short TTL (1h) + MFA enforcement. For KMS, create a key policy allowing decrypt via the KMS proxy principal only. Do NOT add assessors directly to key policy.
sec-bot: [auto] pen-test intake checklist: intake form received, SOW attached, assessor roster, evidence bucket created, readroom creds: pending.
maria (sec): Can we get exact commands for the ephemeral role create? I want this documented in the runbook.
ajay: Snippet (IAM infra as code):
```
resource "aws_iam_role" "assessor_role" {
  name = "pen_test_assessor"
  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17",
    Statement = [{
      Effect = "Allow",
      Principal = { Federated = ["cognito-identity.amazonaws.com"] },
      Action = "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
      Condition = { "NumericLessThanEquals" : { "aws:MultiFactorAuthAge": "3600" } }
    }]
  })
}
```
ajay: (also add session duration = 3600 and attached policy with s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pen-test-evidence/*)
kevin (infra): For KMS proxy: we'll create a proxy service account, key policy snippet: `Principal: { AWS: "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/kms-proxy" }` -> Allow Encrypt/Decrypt. Assessors only get proxy assume, not direct key usage.
donna (sre): For audit logging, ensure CloudTrail data events for that bucket are on and pushed to the audit account. Also enable object-level logging in the S3 bucket.
ajay: I'll open the remediation tracker ticket and add columns: vuln-id, severity, owner, fixed-by, evidence-path, retest-window. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PEN-1234 (internal)
sam (pm): PM note — product will freeze config deploys during the testing window. Any hotfixes must go through an emergency gate.
maria (sec): Retest cadence? If they find issues, how quickly can we schedule a retest slot?
donna (sre): We can offer next-week slots Tue/Thu mornings. If high severity -> we try to get a midweek dry-run same week.
ajay: Operational checklist before handoff: 1) create assessor roles 2) populate assessor roster 3) pre-seed presigned URLs for readroom artifacts 4) verify KMS proxy routes 5) CloudTrail streaming to audit log 6) smoke test assume-role.
kevin (infra): Quick verification commands: `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pen_test_assessor --role-session-name test --duration-seconds 3600` then `aws s3 ls s3://redwood-pen-test-evidence --profile temp`
maria (sec): Can @ajay and @kevin do a dry-run tomorrow 14:00 PT and post the smoke logs here? I want the runbook updated before Monday.
ajay: I'll run the dry-run and paste outputs.
kevin (infra): I'll stand by and validate KMS proxy pathing.
sec-bot: [auto] dry-run scheduled: 1769130000 (tomorrow 14:00 PT). Reminder will ping channel 30m before.
maria (sec): Thanks — also note we need a labelled evidence taxonomy so assessors upload artifacts to /assessor-uploads/{assessor-id}/ and we can easily map to vuln tickets. Add that to tracker.
ajay: Added tagging schema to PEN-1234 under "evidence-schema".
donna (sre): If anything during testing looks like active exploit attempts, escalate to incident channel and pause the test.
maria (sec): Agreed. Final ask: everyone drop a one-line ack if they can attend the dry-run and own their bits.
ajay: ack.
kevin (infra): ack.
donna (sre): ack.
sam (pm): ack.
maria (sec): ack, thanks all — I'll close intake form after dry-run verification.
